title: ASR4REAL: AN EXTENDED BENCHMARK FOR SPEECH MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Word Error Rate (WER) of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models across speakers with different native and non-native accents (e.g., European, Asian, Indian) using datasets like ALLSSTAR, NISP, and VoxPopuli.
Evaluating and correlating the Word Error Rate (WER) of models with the socioeconomic background of the speakers (upper vs. lower working class) using the CORAAL dataset.
Comparing median Word Error Rate (WER) between male and female speakers across various read and conversational speech datasets to identify performance disparities.
Analyzing speech recognition performance on African-American Vernacular English (AAVE) speakers using the CORAAL dataset to identify disparities driven by ethnicity or dialect.
